defects.class: out-of-bounds raw pointer in des_ede3_unwrap's in-place arm (AGENTS.md sections 2 and 17)
defects.description: The authority's in-place branch performs `in -= 8` and adds the block back at each later use (`e_des3.c:335`). The transcription reproduced it with `in_.sub(8)`. Rust requires every intermediate raw-pointer offset to stay within the allocation; the authority's C is likewise pointer arithmetic before the object. The subsequent `add(8)` cancelled the subtraction, so the addresses were correct while the intermediate pointer was not.
defects.fix: Compute the two later sources directly: in-place `(in_, in_.add(inl - 16))`, otherwise `(in_.add(8), in_.add(inl - 8))`. Both are exactly the addresses the authority reaches, with no out-of-bounds intermediate. Control: evp::e_des3::tests::in_place_unwrap_round_trips wraps and then unwraps a 32-byte value in place and requires the plaintext back.
defects.divergence: None observable: the dereferenced addresses are identical. The authority's intermediate pointer UB is not reproduced.

defects.class: caller-supplied length passed to memcmp against a fixed-size field (AGENTS.md sections 1 and 17)
defects.description: CTLOG_STORE_get0_log_by_id compared `log->log_id` (CT_V1_HASHLEN = 32 bytes) using the caller's `log_id_len` with no upper bound. A caller passing more than 32 read past the field, in the authority (ct_log.c:330, in 3.5.9 and 3.6.4) and in the transcription.
defects.fix: Return NULL unless `log_id_len == CT_V1_HASHLEN`, then compare exactly 32 bytes. Control: ct::ct_log::tests::an_over_long_log_id_is_refused_without_reading_past_the_field exercises 32, 33 and 0 with a 32-byte id array.
defects.divergence: For a length other than 32 the authority's C reads out of bounds; this crate answers NULL (no log). A v1 log ID is always 32 bytes, so conforming callers observe no change.

defects.class: provider-reported return_size trusted as the readable extent of a fixed stack buffer (AGENTS.md sections 21.1 and 21.4)
defects.description: rsa_cms_sign hands a 128-byte stack buffer to EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_params and then passes `params[0].return_size` to d2i_X509_ALGOR. A provider that reports more than it was given makes the decoder read past the buffer. The authority trusts the report identically.
defects.fix: Bound the report with `aid_len == 0 || aid_len > aid.len()` and refuse, the same 0 outcome as the other get_params failures. A conforming provider is unaffected.
defects.divergence: A non-conforming provider is refused instead of causing an out-of-bounds read. This is a defensive bound; no conforming input changes.

defects.class: unchecked signed sums used as a growth test and allocation extent (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: a2i_ASN1_INTEGER and a2i_ASN1_STRING use `num + i` to decide whether to grow and `num + i * 2` as the new allocation size, both in int. A multi-gigabyte textual value can overflow the sum; a wrapped non-positive test can skip growth while the write loop still addresses `num + jj`, and a wrapped extent is not a valid allocation size. The authority has the same signed overflow.
defects.fix: Compute `new_num = num.checked_add(i)` and `new_slen = new_num.checked_add(i)`; either overflow answers 0, the readers' existing failure outcome. The non-overflowing path is unchanged. No test function exists; the affected functions have no unit-test entry point without a multi-gigabyte BIO.
defects.divergence: For a value whose sizes exceed INT_MAX this crate refuses rather than wrapping. No representable test buffer reaches the sum.

defects.class: signed underflow in the reverse-lookup index (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: ossl_property_str computed `idx - 1` on a caller-supplied c_int. For INT_MIN, debug builds panic and the authority's C signed subtraction is undefined. Index 0 must still ask sk_value for -1, which returns NULL.
defects.fix: `idx.wrapping_sub(1)`; every index above INT_MIN is unchanged, index 0 still yields -1, and INT_MIN is a defined out-of-range lookup.
defects.divergence: Only the INT_MIN argument differs, where the authority's C is undefined; it is not a property index any caller can obtain.
